xixi-box opened PR #15269 from xixi-box:fix/issue-15264-68f6475-c0075eaa to bytecodealliance:main:

Fixes #15264

Root cause: Egraph elaboration sinks the running sum to its final use, keeping call results live across subsequent calls and causing quadratic register allocation work.

<!-- oss-scout-job:job-4662e4ff-fcf3-4df0-a0a9-c0075eaa5d06 -->

Tests: cargo run -p cranelift-tools --bin clif-util -- test -v cranelift/filetests/filetests/egraph/running-sum.clif (fails on base; passes with this patch).
Regression coverage: cranelift/filetests/filetests/egraph/running-sum.clif.

AI assistance: Codex helped implement and test this change. oss-scout independently replayed the regression before opening this PR.
